newsitem.title: USA: Cygne Designs sees loss for fiscal 1997.
newsitem.headline: Cygne Designs sees loss for fiscal 1997.

text.p: Cygne Designs Inc said Friday it expects a net loss for fiscal 1997, and anticipates it will to incur additional costs associated with the further restructuring or downsizing of its operations.

The company said the extent of the loss will depend, among other things, on the amount of sales and related gross profit from sales to Limited Inc and from sales of, and start- up expenses related to, Kenzo Jeans and Kenzo Studio brand name products.
The company said sales to The Limited decreased in both fiscal 1995 and fiscal 1996, and its expects sales to continue to decrease.
The company said its fiscal year ends January 31, 1998.
The company reported fourth quarter share losses of $0.16 compared to losses of $5.87 for the same period a year ago.
